items.content_html:
Changelog for fedramp.gov/legacy

This page contains summaries of changes that are made to the Legacy section of this site.

An RSS feed for this page is available here.

2026-10-27 Updating static site version and testing RSS feed support

This version makes no changes to the materials on the site itself and is purely for convenience and testing:

  • A Changelog page was added (you are here)
  • The underlying static site builder was updated to the latest version
  • Social media sharing card support was added
  • RSS support for updates to the Changelog is being tested
